# Sodoit

> Sodoit is a bucket list and experience discovery platform for finding fun, memorable, and inspiring things to do.

## About

Sodoit helps people discover bucket list ideas, find new experiences, save things they want to do, organize them into collections, and keep track of what they have completed.

## Main sections

- Browse Experiences: https://www.sodoit.cc/
- Discovery: https://www.sodoit.cc/discovery
- Guides: https://www.sodoit.cc/guides
- Public Profiles: https://www.sodoit.cc/u/{username}
- Public Collections: https://www.sodoit.cc/u/{username}/collections/{slug}

## Content

Sodoit includes public Experiences, curated Guides, public Collections, and public user Profiles.

Experiences cover travel, adventure, food, nature, wellness, learning, entertainment, and other memorable things worth doing.

Private Profiles and Collections are not publicly indexed.
